items.title: Sakana AI establishes Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) Lab
items.summary_en: Sakana AI announced a dedicated research group, the RSI Lab, tasked with redesigning the AI development process itself using AI. The post sits within the company's earlier self-improving-AI work, such as the Darwin Gödel Machine.
items.notes: sakana.ai blocked; content from search snippets; date may predate the 2026-09-26 window.

items.title: Jürgen Schmidhuber joins Sakana AI as Chief Scientific Advisor
items.summary_en: Sakana AI welcomed Jürgen Schmidhuber as Chief Scientific Advisor. He is to help guide the RSI Lab's research direction and will reportedly be in Tokyo regularly.
